notes: Kodansha LN Bunko. Minimal EPUB3 TOC (cover + TOC page + colophon only). Chapters detected by in-content heading markers. Uses p### page numbering with spreads for kuchie.

exclude.notes: Non-story end-matter images (colophon decoration, author profile photo)

kuchie.notes: Pages 1-8 reserved for color frontispiece (kuchie). Double-spread format common (p002-003.jpg). p008 is the title/contents page image.

illustrations.notes: In-body illustrations numbered from p010 upward. Some volumes use double-spreads for bonus story illustrations.

heading_patterns: ^###\s+[一二三四五六七八九十百千]+章.*$
^###\s+[一二三四五六七八九十百千]+章[（(][前後][）)].*$
title_patterns: ^[一二三四五六七八九十百千]+章
